university.name: Nottingham Trent University
university.summary: A university in Nottingham with a dedicated Pakistan page that sets out entry guidance by qualification, including a foundation route at Nottingham Trent International College for HSSC holders, and lists scholarships for Pakistani applicants.

courses.title: Management (International Business)
courses.duration_text: One year full-time, or two years with a work placement (September starters)
courses.overview: A taught master's at City Campus in Nottingham Business School covering strategy, operations, marketing, finance and international management, finishing with a consultancy or business research project. A placement route is available to September starters.
highlights: Global Leadership, People and Artificial Intelligence
Consultancy Experience Project or Business Research Project (final project, choose one)
courses.academic_requirements: One-year course: a degree equivalent to a UK undergraduate honours degree (2.2 or above). Two-year placement course: a UK-equivalent honours degree at 2.1 or above. Applicants must show commitment to the subject.
courses.english_requirements: Nottingham Business School 1-year Masters (Student visa): IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each component. Two-year Masters (Student visa): 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 in speaking and listening and 5.5 in reading and writing. PTE Academic 62 with no element below 59 (equivalent to IELTS 6.5 with 5.5). Duolingo is not accepted. TOEFL iBT is listed on a new scale from January 2026: 4.5 overall with at least 4.0 in each component for the IELTS 6.5 equivalent.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page, four-year bachelor's for postgraduate entry: CGPA 2.5 for courses requiring a 2:2 and 2.9 for courses requiring a 2:1 (scale not stated). Graduates of NUST, Quaid-i-Azam University or LUMS: 2.3 for a 2:2 and 2.7 for a 2:1. University of the Punjab: 50% for a 2:2 and 55% for a 2:1. Described as guidelines only.
courses.notes: The course page does not state the fee year; it is the 2027 version of the page and the GBP 21,600 figure also appears on the 2027/28 international tuition fees page. Placement year fee GBP 2,010 for 2027/28. English bands are from the general English language requirements page. Module core or optional status is not shown.

courses.title: Digital Finance and Data Analytics
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's at City Campus combining financial markets, programming and data analytics for finance, financial technology, empirical finance and machine learning in finance, with a consultancy project.
highlights: Principles of Machine Learning in Finance
Consultancy Experience Project (core or optional status not shown)
courses.academic_requirements: An undergraduate degree equivalent to a UK honours degree at 2.2 or above with some evidence of quantitative ability, one academic reference and demonstrated commitment to the subject.
courses.english_requirements: Not given on the course page. General page for Nottingham Business School 1-year Masters (Student visa): IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each component. PTE Academic 62 with no element below 59. Duolingo is not accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page, four-year bachelor's for postgraduate entry: CGPA 2.5 for courses requiring a 2:2 and 2.9 for courses requiring a 2:1 (scale not stated). Graduates of NUST, Quaid-i-Azam University or LUMS: 2.3 for a 2:2 and 2.7 for a 2:1. University of the Punjab: 50% for a 2:2 and 55% for a 2:1. Described as guidelines only.
courses.application_deadline_note: Course page shows a September 2026 start only; no September 2027 start is shown
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published on the course page; the fee year is not stated and is taken as the 2026/27 page. The 2027/28 international fees page lists GBP 21,150 among full-time Masters fees but does not name courses. No 2027 intake is shown, so no intake is recorded.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: One year full-time, two years full-time with one year placement, two years part-time
courses.overview: A taught master's at Clifton Campus covering advanced software engineering, systems analysis and design, cloud technologies, applied artificial intelligence and mobile interactive systems, with a major project.
courses.academic_requirements: 2.2 honours degree or equivalent in a Computer Science or computing related subject. Relevant employment experience or other qualifications also considered.
courses.english_requirements: Not published for this course. The general English requirements page leaves the School of Science and Technology Masters row empty and directs applicants to international@ntu.ac.uk. Duolingo is not accepted.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page, four-year bachelor's for postgraduate entry: CGPA 2.5 for courses requiring a 2:2 (scale not stated). Graduates of NUST, Quaid-i-Azam University or LUMS: 2.3 for a 2:2. University of the Punjab: 50% for a 2:2. Described as guidelines only.
courses.application_deadline_note: Course page shows a September 2026 start only; no September 2027 start is shown
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published; GBP 19,900 is the 2026/27 page fee (GBP 1,905 extra for the placement year). English requirement for the School of Science and Technology is not published, so structured English fields are null.

scholarships.name: Country Scholarship for Pakistan
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 towards studies for postgraduate students holding an offer
scholarships.summary: A competitive country award of GBP 5,000 for Pakistani postgraduate applicants with a full-time Masters offer, applied for through a single scholarship application form.
scholarships.criteria_text: Full-time Masters offer at NTU, overseas fee status, not currently enrolled at NTU and not sponsored in full or part. Competitive.
scholarships.deadline_note: January 2027 entry: first deadline 30 September 2026, final deadline 31 October 2026 16:00 GMT. September 2027 scheme opens later in the year, details not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Terms are published for January 2027 entry only. The Pakistan page repeats the GBP 5,000 figure without dates.

scholarships.name: Prestigious University Award (Pakistan)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 4,000 for a first class degree, GBP 3,000 for a 2:1
scholarships.summary: A merit award for high-achieving students from 14 listed Pakistani institutions, new from September 2027 entry. Applicants complete the application form; a scholarship statement is not needed if applying only for this award.
scholarships.criteria_text: Graduates of listed Pakistani institutions including LUMS, NUST, FAST-NUCES, Quaid-i-Azam University and University of the Punjab. A 1st earns GBP 4,000 and a 2:1 earns GBP 3,000.
scholarships.notes: Study levels covered are not specified on the Pakistan page, so levels is left empty. Whether an offer is required is not stated.

scholarships.name: NTU International Merit Scholarship (Masters)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 3,000 (a lower NTU International Scholarship of GBP 2,000 is also listed for Masters)
scholarships.summary: A competitive award for international Masters applicants assessed through the single NTU scholarship application form. A GBP 2,000 NTU International Scholarship for Masters sits alongside it.
scholarships.criteria_text: Full-time Masters offer at NTU, overseas fee status, not currently enrolled at NTU and not sponsored in full or part.
scholarships.deadline_note: January 2027 entry: first deadline 30 September 2026, final deadline 31 October 2026 16:00 GMT. September 2027 scheme opens later in the year, details not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Terms published for January 2027 entry only.

scholarships.name: NTU Excellence Scholarships
scholarships.value_text: 50% or 25% off the first-year fee (GBP 9,150 to 12,500 or GBP 4,525 to 6,250 depending on course fee); undergraduates also receive GBP 3,000 off each later year
scholarships.summary: A competitive award of 50% or 25% off first-year tuition for international Bachelors and Masters applicants, decided on the strength of the application.
scholarships.criteria_text: Full-time Bachelors or Masters offer at NTU, overseas fee status, not currently enrolled at NTU and not sponsored in full or part. Based on application strength.
scholarships.deadline_note: January 2027 entry: first deadline 30 September 2026, final deadline 31 October 2026 16:00 GMT. September 2027 scheme opens later in the year, details not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Value is 50% or 25% depending on the award; the 50% figure is recorded in value_percent.

scholarships.name: Sibling Loyalty Reward
scholarships.value_text: 20% off tuition fees, first year only
scholarships.summary: A first-year fee reduction for international students whose sibling studies at NTU. Claimed by email with both siblings' birth certificates and NTU ID numbers.
scholarships.criteria_text: You and your sibling must share at least one parent. A sibling currently at NTU qualifies only if also in first year.
scholarships.notes: Levels are inferred from the page applying to full-time Bachelors or Masters offers. September 2027 terms not yet published.
